snippet.title: Enigma Heart | teaser trailer
snippet.description:
Coming soon for Linux and Windows!
---
In a high adventure tale of old, guide the young heroine Zalia on a crusade against evil forces threatening her world! Inspired by early action RPG classics, you'll travel the world, bask in the comforting glow of a tavern fire, battle wicked monsters, fight to free your world from the clutches of evil, and even find love in the arms a beautiful tavern keeper in... ENIGMA HEART!
